description: Best and worst selling dishes (by net sales) for a date range, with quantity sold. The worst list only has dishes that sold at least once in the range.

parameters.label: End Date
parameters.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future. Range is at most 366 days.

parameters.label: Limit
parameters.description: How many dishes per list, 1 to 20. Default 5.
